If a rule requires a player who has left the game to make a choice, the next player in turn order makes that choice.
In Free-for-All multiplayer games, a group of players compete as individuals against each other.
A player still in the game wins the game if that player’s opponents have all left the game. This happens immediately and overrides all effects that would preclude that player from winning the game.
